items.title: [Bug] Too many positional options have been specified on the command line
items.body:
I tried to run this command

`valhalla_build_admins --config south-america-latest.osm.pbf north-america-latest.osm.pbf africa-latest.osm.pbf central-america-latest.osm.pbf australia-oceania-latest.osm.pbf europe-latest.osm.pbf afghanistan-latest.osm.pbf armenia-latest.osm.pbf azerbaijan-latest.osm.pbf bangladesh-latest.osm.pbf bhutan-latest.osm.pbf cambodia-latest.osm.pbf china-latest.osm.pbf gcc-states-latest.osm.pbf india-latest.osm.pbf indonesia-latest.osm.pbf iran-latest.osm.pbf iraq-latest.osm.pbf israel-and-palestine-latest.osm.pbf japan-latest.osm.pbf jordan-latest.osm.pbf kazakhstan-latest.osm.pbf kyrgyzstan-latest.osm.pbf laos-latest.osm.pbf lebanon-latest.osm.pbf malaysia-singapore-brunei-latest.osm.pbf maldives-latest.osm.pbf mongolia-latest.osm.pbf myanmar-latest.osm.pbf nepal-latest.osm.pbf  pakistan-latest.osm.pbf phillippines-latest.osm.pbf south-korea-latest.osm.pbf sri-lanka-latest.osm.pbf syria-latest.osm.pbf taiwan-latest.osm.pbf tajikistan-latest.osm.pbf thailand-latest.osm.pbf turkmenistan-latest.osm.pbf uzbekistan-latest.osm.pbf vietnam-latest.osm.pbf yemen-latest.osm.pbf`

After I pressed enter I got the message:

`Unable to parse command line options because: too many positional options have been specified on the command line
This is a bug, please report it at https://github.com/valhalla/issues`

I'm running the current master branch on my Macbook. I was basically trying North America, South America, Africa, Australia and Oceania, Central America, Europe, and all the individual countries in Asia. I found that on the Geofabrik data Russia is in both Europe and Asia and because I was having an issue with bug #1968 I would try something different.
